intent: Three-plan pricing section for a fictional accounting tool, Ledgerly: light stone neutrals, an inverted taller featured card, a sliding monthly/annual toggle and odometer prices.

stack.fonts: font-display (Bricolage Grotesque), font-serif (Instrument Serif), font-sans (Geist), font-mono (Geist Mono)

header: row: body (max 52ch) left, billing toggle right; stacked below lg
layout.plans: 3-col grid at lg (gap 16px), stacked below (gap 32px); featured card -my-5 at lg with larger padding so it stands taller
layout.mdCard: at md each card is 2 columns: name/price/CTA left, features right with a vertical rule
layout.footnotes: rule, then 2-col ordered list with mono 01/02 markers

motion.toggleIndicator: shared layoutId pill, spring stiffness 420 damping 36, scoped by LayoutGroup id
motion.price: odometer: per-digit 0-9 column, y = -digit * 1.1em, spring stiffness 140 damping 20, 70ms stagger, keyed from the right
motion.cta: lift 2px on hover; arrow chip nudges right

responsive.mobile: stacked cards, toggle under body, featured card stays inverted with its sticker
responsive.md: cards split into two inner columns

accessibility: toggle is role=radiogroup with role=radio, aria-checked, roving tabindex and arrow keys
odometer aria-hidden with an sr-only price sentence
each card is an article named after its plan

content.title: Priced like a good accountant: no surprises.

plans.name: Practice
plans.audience: For small teams with a real payroll

avoid: gradient borders or glows on the popular plan
fading the whole price instead of rolling digits
